decisions.decision: v1 and v1.1 ship as a signed personal-use Android APK via personal-apk.yml; the public-release ceremony (attended device matrix, owner-approval token, no-rebuild Release promotion, Terminal Seal) is retired and tracked as V2-05

decisions.decision: Reorient the active workout to an overview-first, single scrollable exercise list (D-03/D-06); land anchored on the active set (D-05); unify empty/unplanned workout into the same overview (D-07)
decisions.rationale: Owner-approved UX reorientation based on Hevy/Liftin' references; retires the v1.0 dual focused/review mode.

decisions.decision: Completed workout history is row-level append-only immutable (WORK-24, reframing WORK-04); replace keeps the original exercise as skipped (Q6); edits are modified-from-plan
decisions.rationale: WORK-04 must not be weakened; completed sets keep correction/undo/history semantics.

decisions.decision: End-of-workout 'save changes to plan?' opt-in defaults to No (Q9)
decisions.rationale: Owner default: do not write back to the plan unless explicitly chosen.

decisions.decision: Advanced set timing supports BOTH per-rep cadence AND cluster-set intra-rest modes (Q10); cues are advisory-only and never authoritative over recorded facts

Backup is one canonical portable versioned encrypted archive that restores clean OR merges (authenticated, conflict-ruled, previewed, all-or-nothing); records get stable owner-scoped portable identities (schema 21)
decisions.rationale: Owner wants a central place to keep history/backup and restore to any personal device (DATA-08/09).

decisions.decision: Automatic sync uses the owner's OWN Google Drive (One-Tap sign-in, drive.file scope), one app-created client-side-encrypted store, passphrase-derived key; reuse helper-payroll-app's Google sign-in + Drive + Noble-cipher patterns but NOT its Firestore transport; sync is derivative replication over the Phase 11 merge engine and never blocks the offline workout path
decisions.rationale: Owner chose automatic sync (Q13/DATA-10) across personal devices.
